scenarios.title: Authentication
scenarios.assertion: A new synthetic user can sign up and sign in; invalid credentials are rejected.

scenarios.title: Article creation
scenarios.assertion: The published title and body match the entered values.

scenarios.title: Article ownership
scenarios.assertion: Only the author can modify their article.

scenarios.title: Comment and favorite
scenarios.assertion: The comment persists after reload and the favorite appears on the profile.

scenarios.title: Pagination
scenarios.assertion: Known fixture articles appear on the correct pages without duplication.
